    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.exists_iso_square_of_rigid_pair_polynomial (k : Type v) [Field k] {C : Type u_1} [CategoryTheory.Category.{u_2, u_1} C] [CategoryTheory.Preadditive C] [CategoryTheory.Linear k C] {X Y : C} (p q : X ⟶ Y) [Module.Finite k (X ⟶ X)] [Module.Finite k (Y ⟶ Y)] [Module.Finite k (X ⟶ Y)] (hp : Function.Surjective ⇑(boundaryLinear k p p)) (hq : Function.Surjective ⇑(boundaryLinear k q q)) :
    ∃ (d : Polynomial k), d ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ {F : Type w} [inst : Field F] [inst_1 : Algebra k F] (e : Polynomial k →ₐ[k] F), e d ≠ 0 → have G := ScalarCategory.of; ∃ (a : G.obj X ≅ G.obj X) (b : G.obj Y ≅ G.obj Y), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp a.hom (G.map q) = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (G.map p) b.hom

    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.exists_finite_field_iso_square_of_rigid_pair (k : Type v) [Field k] {C : Type u_1} [CategoryTheory.Category.{u_2, u_1} C] [CategoryTheory.Preadditive C] [CategoryTheory.Linear k C] [Finite k] {X Y : C} (p q : X ⟶ Y) [Module.Finite k (X ⟶ X)] [Module.Finite k (Y ⟶ Y)] [Module.Finite k (X ⟶ Y)] (hp : Function.Surjective ⇑(boundaryLinear k p p)) (hq : Function.Surjective ⇑(boundaryLinear k q q)) :
    ∃ (F : Type v) (x : Field F) (x_1 : Algebra k F), Finite F ∧ have G := ScalarCategory.of; ∃ (a : G.obj X ≅ G.obj X) (b : G.obj Y ≅ G.obj Y), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp a.hom (G.map q) = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (G.map p) b.hom

    Over a finite field, any two rigid differentials on fixed terms become isomorphic over a finite extension.
